claim: Japan's energy self-sufficiency rate stood at 16.4% in fiscal year 2024.
Japan aims to generate 30 to 45 GW from offshore wind by 2040.
As of 2024, wind power (onshore and offshore) provided 1% of electricity generation in Japan.
A turbine with 1,500,000 J energy output in 10 s has a power of 150,000 W (150 kW).
A turbine with 3,000,000 J energy output in 15 s has a power of 200,000 W (200 kW).
A turbine with 800,000 J energy output in 5 s has a power of 160,000 W (160 kW).
Power measures the rate of energy transfer.
